title: Cotopaxi Allpa 35 review: the organization king — PackHacker
text: The Allpa 35 is what happens when a suitcase and a backpack raise a very tidy child. The full-wrap zipper opens the bag completely flat: mesh-covered main compartment on the right, subdivided zippered sections on the left — after two weeks we stopped bringing packing cubes entirely, which no other pack has achieved. The dedicated laptop and tablet sleeves load from the top so airport security is painless. Carry is good, not great: the padded straps and removable hipbelt handle medium loads happily, though it lacks the ventilated structure of a true suspension pack on multi-hour walks. Build is tank-like: TPU-coated 1000D shell, 840D ballistic panels, security zippers that survived a Barcelona pickpocket attempt in our tester's own words. It is 1.6 kg and $200, and the colorful Del Día look is either your favorite thing or a dealbreaker. Guaranteed for Good lifetime warranty seals it: best-in-class organization, mid-pack comfort, premium price.
